claims: Speculation that Codex will be merged into ChatGPT within the next week, during OpenAI's '28 days' rollout; nobody knows the date
Main user concern: whether free/Plus limits will be pooled between Chat and Codex
Feedback from users says keep the two products separate because they do different things
on_screen_only: X post by Token Gremlin (@TokenGremlin): 'Now it's official: regular ChatGPT Chats are starting to get agentic features, including subagents that we previously only saw in Work and Codex. These are the first real signs that Chat is being merged with Work, Codex, and Dots, and I wouldn't be surprised if we start seeing this much more clearly during Tibo's "28 improvements" rollout. OpenAI, I'm asking for one thing: be generous with the limits (especially for Plus users!), and PLEASE don't kill ChatGPT's personality by stuffing it with agentic features if that ends up making the conversation experience worse.'
Overlay: 'CHATGPT TO BE MERGED WITH CODEX?! GOOD OR BAD?'
